name: Unity Camera Movement
goalName: Make the camera follow a path using waypoints with smooth movement and rotation
goal: For our game, we need an uncontrollable camera, which follows a preset path. To make it look good, there needs to be smooth rotation and movement. (no snapping)

approach.text:
<<source How to know if an object is looking at an other - Unity Answers. (2015, July 19). Answers.Unity.Com. https://answers.unity.com/questions/1010169/how-to-know-if-an-object-is-looking-at-an-other.html>>
<<source Smooth look at. (2009, Summer). Unity Forum. https://forum.unity.com/threads/smooth-look-at.26141/>>

result: As seen in the video below, the camera moves on its own and turns automatically to the next waypoint. The movement and rotation is smooth as well.<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/27YT8_-qdtE>>
validation: I tested the script with multiple waypoints on different locations. Each test result was a succes. My fellow peers said the result was looking good.
contribution: Now the camera and waypoints are in place, I can resume to make enemies. These need to be loaded in at specific points. The camera also needs to stop as soon as the player encounters the enemies.
